fields.label: Project engagement name
fields.description: Private candidate project name. It must begin with the exact operator-supplied organization short name followed by a colon and space.

fields.label: Organization short name
fields.description: Private exact short name used only to validate the candidate project-name prefix; it is not inferred from provider layout or displayed in sanitized inspection.

fields.label: Organization reference
fields.description: Exact authoritative portable CRM Organization resource for this candidate. Project Capture requires one Organization and its private exact short name; it does not accept a provider-native relation identifier.

fields.label: Creation profile
fields.description: Exact governed portable creation profile selected independently from any provider-native template behavior.

fields.label: Project type
fields.description: Candidate portable project classification revalidated against the selected creation profile, governed policy, and current provider schema.

fields.label: Project overview
fields.description: Private evidence-grounded overview retained only in selected local review material and the exact reviewed create body; it is absent from sanitized inspection.

fields.label: Milestone titles
fields.description: Private ordered outcome titles. This list must have exactly the same number of entries as descriptions, owners, actions, and any supplied dates.

fields.label: Milestone descriptions
fields.description: Private ordered one-line outcome descriptions paired positionally with milestone titles.

fields.label: Milestone work owners
fields.description: Private ordered single-owner tokens paired positionally with milestone actions. Multiple owners per action are intentionally unavailable in this portable profile.

fields.label: Milestone work actions
fields.description: Private ordered concrete actions paired positionally with milestone titles and owners.

fields.label: Milestone work dates
fields.description: Optional private ordered exact dates. When supplied, every milestone requires one YYYY-MM-DD entry; omission makes every initial work item undated.

fields.label: Start date
fields.description: Optional private project start date pinned exactly as YYYY-MM-DD rather than a relative phrase.

fields.label: Target end date
fields.description: Optional private target end date pinned exactly as YYYY-MM-DD and required to be no earlier than the start date.
